reason: The plugin is primarily a web UI localization and interface usability enhancement for DSH, focused on translating displayed slash-command and plugin-card text and adding list organization features like category filtering and source badges for easier recognition, with behavior described as client-side web mutations in the provided manifest and README.

summaries.zh: 一个用于 DSH Web 的插件，可在中文界面下本地化斜杠命令和插件列表卡片文本，并支持中文、双语或不翻译三种展示模式，同时新增插件分类筛选与来源标识。
summaries.en: This plugin enhances the DSH Web UI by localizing slash-command and plugin-card text, with Chinese-only, bilingual, or no-translation display modes plus plugin category filters and source badges.

capabilities: Rewrites visible text in the DSH web interface for slash commands and plugin cards.
Injects runtime UI behavior into the web client via configured client-side plugin injection.
Adds plugin-list controls such as category tabs and source badges for filtering/identification.

reasons.code: Package manifest config declares a web client plugin with injection dependencies for locale and UI settings, indicating browser-side operation.
README notes MutationObserver-based DOM rewriting of command/menu rows and plugin card title/description, with original text preserved in a data attribute.
README documents the plugin-list category bar and source badges (official/self-made/third-party), confirming navigation/UI augmentation in the interface.
